about: Contact details victim runs give to the sites they visit. Documented in docs/victim-contacts.md. Change the version whenever a value changes; every run records the version it used.

local.about: Runs on this machine only: the case-61 replay and the fixture pages. Nothing typed here leaves the machine. The numbers are fictional and are never used on a live site.

live.about: Live sites. E-mail: one disposable mail.tm inbox per run, created when the run starts; read it later with `ftf victim mail <run folder>`. Phones: fill in once a range that cannot be assigned is confirmed (requirements section 13, question 1); until then forms that require a phone stop the run.
